description: This file defines the ReadableOrderTotal class, which extends OrderTotal and implements Serializable. It provides a getter and setter for the 'total' property, representing the total amount in a readable format within an order context.

classes.name: ReadableOrderTotal
classes.description: A Java class extending OrderTotal, implementing Serializable, providing access to the 'total' property.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the 'total' amount as a String.
